notes.title: 2025.4.20:1.9.1 version, multiplayer mode
notes.content:
After a period of development and internal testing, I have released version 1.9.1 the multiplayer version .
Add:
1. Internet games, including the PVE mode of team coop, currently have only one map, PVP mode with the goal of annihilating hostile players. At present, there are three maps. Internet games can only random matchingmaking now. Only have servers in Shanghai. For foreign players, East Asia can try to connect. Other regions should not be able to play Internet games normally because of the high latency.
2. In LAN games, players can play online games with players on the same LAN or use virtual LAN technology to play online games on the Internet.
3. The game scenes have been completely remade, enhancing the design of special buildings.
4. Partially Remake the characters and outfit.
5. Partially Remake the sound effects of the weapon.
6. Remake All character animations.
7. Upgrade the engine to Unity6.
Delete:
1. In order to materialize online gaming, vehicles have been transformed into a type of players. Therefore, all vehicles and related tasks in single player campaigns have been removed, and the conditions for unlocking achievements have been adjusted.
2. In order to materialize online gaming, the third person firearm model cannot be affected by modifications.
3. For the sake of PVP gameplay, the third person aiming mode has been removed.
4. Remove bullet time.
Attention:
1. Throw item to ground in multiplayer games currently has no effect.
2. Due to the rework of the asset management system, the workshop is temporarily unavailable and will be restored next month.
3. If you want to play PVE maps in single player, you can create a  LAN game. Do not enter the online map through urea tool.

As this is the first large-scale testing for multiplayer, there may be some bugs. If you encounter any bugs, you can provide feedback below this announcement.

notes.title: 2024.11.12：Recent Progress and Update Preview
notes.content:
In the past two months, I have been optimizing the content and features of the game, but the current game is not suitable for updates. Moreover, Unity6 was released last month, and upgrading the engine to Unity6 will be helpful for the performance of the game and multiplayer game development. Therefore, I have also spent some time preparing for the engine upgrade. I plan to release a major update in December.
Recently, I have mainly done these things:
1. Added prone function, AI will also prone and shoot when far away from the target.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43045814/3b45444cb0fe0438801394725cef64f2b9e4f780.png[/img]
2. Rework the scene, improve game performance.
3. Developed some shaders, improve the rendering of characters, and achieved high-performance large-scale dynamic grassland effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43045814/b0cfa2729a9619f0624a8860ba77129e9e4cb199.png[/img]
4. Added an assault rifle.
5. Optimized the handling of the vehicle.
6. Other mechanism optimizations, such as: the damage of grenades will be blocked by walls, remove the suppression effect, and the accuracy of AI throwing grenades will be reduced.
What I will do before the December update:
1. Upgrade the game engine to Unity6.
2. Develop multiplayer Co-op mode based on LAN.
3. Add special skills based on the original Touhou Project setting for the existing 2-3 characters in the game, including special animation.

notes.title: 2024.7.16: The game has been fixed, How to correctly switch to alpha version
notes.content:
The game has been fixed. At the same time, two beta versions will be added, one based on a version that is one to two months earlier than the current version, which can be directly switched to play. One is based on the 2022 alpha and has early version gameplay, but switching to alpha versions requires changing the settings file, otherwise the game cannot start normally. Here are the specific methods:
1. Before switching to the alpha version, locate the \ E.E.R.I.E2-Data \ StreamingAssets \ Settings.txt file in the game directory, back up and delete this file.
2. Switching to alpha version, as a missing Settings. txt file has been detected, Steam will automatically download the alpha version Settings. txt file.
3. Before switching back to the latest version, move the previously backed up latest version Settings. txt file back and overwrite the alpha version Settings. txt file.

notes.title: Announcement: Update notice of completed weapon system and new equipment system
notes.content:
There are no information and updates released since Chinese new year, I'm sorry, I'd also like to upload my two weeks' results to the game now, but I'm worried that the incomplete system will cause more problems, so I intend to complete all the associated systems and then make a big update at the end of this month, here is the current progress and plan:
1. Final weapon system：
Compared with the currently available version, the final weapon system adds the following functions:
① Complete ammunition management: press and hold the U key to unload the magazine, press and hold the R key to insert a bullet into the chamber, and press the I key to pull charging handle to eject the bullet. Press and hold the I key to check the chamber. It will form a complete ammunition management system together with the backpack and equipment system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43045814/8f3b05b3a778475fca92e88686508a6fc8a84586.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43045814/6616b8dadd44fb1e36ba23245ee71d6879528347.png[/img]
② Adjustable sight: the [key and] key can adjust the range, the<key and the>key can adjust the magnification of the sight, the reticle of the sight is realistic, and can predict the dorp of bullets, and implement accurate shooting, which is more useful in the later sandbox map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43045814/52d954b06a75e90ea2d7d09eb1858aa8b1f91319.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43045814/43495a2260cb3806a1c1e16bd7b20d7c2e7c64d3.png[/img]
③ Grenade sight: add grenade sight. Because of the increase number of sights, switch the button of switching sight to mouse wheel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43045814/cf009ec7b654b9c54ea4fee8d621e7e4b184aa46.png[/img]
④ Others: long press the X key to open the safety of the weapon with manual safety device, the V key to turn on the reticle illumination, the U key to expand or fold the stock, which affects the speed of entering the aiming state and the shaking when aiming.
2. Equipment and gear system:
The backpack system of E.E.R.I.E will return. The character will have four equipment slots: belt, vest, helmet or hat, and backpack. The vest can be loaded with bullet-proof plate, and the storage space can be increased except for the equipment on the head. Pressing R to load ammunition can not use the magazine and bullets in the backpack, but only the ones in the belt and vest, The appearance style of the equipment is consistent with that of the weapon: the more realistic military equipment and the fictional equipment with realistic flavor. At present, the system is still in the code stage. The weapon systems that are expected to be completed by the end of this month will be updated into the game together. However, due to time, the number of gears in the first update will be relatively small.
3. Gameplay after this update:
E.E.R.I.E  sandbox gameplay will return, and the geographic size of the level will be around 700M * 700M. Players can decide the order or completion method of the task by themselves, giving players the opportunity to explore independently and shoot in the medium and long range. The two existing linear levels will be transformed into tutorials, but this is not the content updated at the end of this month. Only a simple long-distance shooting test level will be added to the game in the update at the end of this month.
4. Other completed changes:
① Change the light mode and reflection probe background to make the weapon looks better.
② The model and material of M4 and Galil are reworked.
③ Improved pistol loading animation.
④ All weapons, accessories and characters have been recalibrated to the size in the real world.
⑤ Change the speed of the bullet according to the real firing table.
⑥ Redo the third person animation system.
⑦ Add the front grip accessories.

See you at the end of the month.

notes.title: Weekly routine update 7: Weapon system upgrades
notes.content:
1. Weapon system upgrade: You can now use weapon chest to customize and generate weapons, depending on the weapon, you can customize the barrel, handguard, handle, stock, grip and other parts. At present, there is no property bonus of the part, which only affects the interface of the accessory. The test map eerie2_test_0 has a weapon chest that can be used an unlimited number of times.
2. Browning "High Power" pistol: Replace the CZ P10 as the standard 9mm pistol in the game to better fit the world setting.
3. UI and HP mechanism adjustment: Now the character will automatically replenish health when starts to restore the shield, so there is no need for health items, health and armor display are replaced by the indicator at the bottom of the screen, and the ammo inventory will only show the type of ammunition corresponding to the weapon currently used.
This week's task is to complete the weapon system by adding more parts to the current weapon, setting different attributes for the part, and adding special mechanics for specific weapons, such as telescopic stocks, tripods, etc., which will no longer change the basic functionality of the weapon system after this week's update, only new weapons and accessories.

notes.title: Weekly routine update 6: A new level: The Pioneer
notes.content:
1. A new level: The Pioneer: Luna woke up in a hospital in Chiran Province, and soon would fight with the enemy who was up to besiege her. The main purpose of this level is to let players become more familiar with basic gun fighting in the game, so it is purely linear and less challenging. The enemy will not use explosives and heavy weapons have not appeared.
Other instructions: because I was infected with COVID-19 this week, I have been cultivating, so the update will be suspended for a week, and will continue to update weekly next week.

notes.title: Announcement: I'm upgrading the weapon system
notes.content:
The content produced this week has not been updated to the game, and will be released as a major update together with the new level next week.
The original plan for this week was to create new level. However, the increase of  levels will inevitably lead to more trouble in upgrading the weapon system. Therefore, before updating the checkpoints, the weapon system has been upgraded. The barrel, handguard, stock and dust cover of the weapon will become parts that can be modified, and special weapons with grenades will be deleted, because the grenade launcher will become a optional part.

notes.title: Weekly routine update 5: battle test map, new health mechanism
notes.content:
1. Battle test map: The battle test scene of the next chapter can be accessed through urea tools if you want to experience them in advance. There is no guidance or plot, so you need to find way by yourself. The next chapter will be officially updated next week.
2. New Health Mechanism: Each character has a armor value. Before the armor value comes to zero, it will not consume HP. The armor value will be automatically restored, and the HP value will not be automatically restored.Melee attack ignoring the armor value directly consumes the target's HP.
3. Tengu melee: Tengu can melee attack now, regardless of armor value. When you hear the sound of drawing a sword, run quickly.

notes.title: Weekly routine update 4：Tengu Type60 Assault rifle
notes.content:
Tengu Type 60 Assault Rifle: The assault rifle designed by Tengu during the Cold War, using M43 ammunition, is the standard weapon of the Tengu race.
Other notes: This week, i have basically completed the scene of the next chapter. Next week, i will optimize the combat system, adding electromagnetic armor, gun cabinet and other elements. In addition, the combat test scene in the next chapter will be released. This scene has no plot content and only contains the combat part, which is used for testing and rapid optimization.

notes.title: Weekly routine update 3：Weapon optimization, New accessories
notes.content:
1. Weapon optimization: The inspection and modification of weapons are divided into two animations. Press the reload key to inspect when cannot reload. The modification key remains unchanged, and the M4 model is optimized.

2. New accessories: add EXPS holographic sight and Tango4 scope.

3. Mechanism change: game will enter freecam mode after the main character down.

Other notes: The main work of this week is modeling of new chapter, which have not been imported into the game, so there is not much updated content. Next week, i will continue to produce new chapter content and update weapons. Because there are a lot of combats, the new chapter may take about two more weeks.

notes.title: Weekly routine update 2：Reisen and Tengu
notes.content:
The second weekly routine update of E.E.R.I.E 2 includes:
1. Reisen: Character from Touhou Project，her skill can temporarily convert an nearby random enemy into a friendly one，her skill mechanism needs to be improved，For example, increase directivity，No voice at present, will be updated later.
2. Tengu: The main enemies in the next chapter，special mechanisms are still being designed.No special voice at present, will be updated later.
Next week's task will be to build the scene for the next chapter.

notes.title: Weekly routine update 1：NSR28 shotgun，Urea tool，A test scene
notes.content:
The first weekly routine update of E.E.R.I.E 2 includes:
1. NSR28 shotgun: The manual shotgun designed and produced by Kappa uses magazine feed. After shooting, you need to press the shooting button again to manually load it. It is equipped with two kinds of ammunition: slug and buckshot.
2. Urea tool: you can look around freely in the scene, generate objects, and load other map in it, Can be opened through the button in the main menu.
3. Test scene: a simple urban environment test scene, which can only be accessed through the urea tool.
Other notes: E.E.R.I.E 2 will be updated once a week before it is completed (it may stop for two weeks during Chinese New Year), and the update date of each week is uncertain.This update will overwrite the previous settings, and the next update will not overwrite them.
